GOAL: orient in the repo and find Issue #126 artefacts before proposing.
READ: working dir listing; results/research/issue126/ search.
OBSERVED: starting orientation.
EVIDENCE: n/a.
REASONING: need to avoid restating rejected proposals and build on the frozen teacher/hard prefix score.
OPEN: which files define the hard Q_H score and the proxy.

STAGE: grounding read attempt (goal: inspect results/research/issue126 teacher+hard Q_H score and the frozen Stage2/Stage3 configs before proposing).
READ: attempted read of /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec and /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/issue126 and of my own workspace dir.
OBSERVED: every path returned permission.rejected (external_directory for repo root, "read" for the workspace dir itself); the session has no write tool and no shell by design.
REASONING: I cannot verify d (latent dim), the RQ depth/codebook size, or the exact definition of Q_H from source, so the proposal is written to be dimension-agnostic and to reuse whatever the frozen Stage-2 encoder already outputs; all constants are stated as derived or as documented defaults so nothing depends on a value I could not read.
OPEN: implementer must confirm latent dim d and RQ depth L before writing the tensors; the proposal itself does not change with those values.

STAGE: design-space scan and selection (goal: pick a region not already occupied by round_20261028_* or issue126).
READ: the round history in the task brief: BRANCHCURV-SID, GEO-SHELL-RQ, GEOPFX-SID, GEO_REPAIR, GYRO-TARGET-RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ, SUCC-TAN-RQ, behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts, cocond-markov-poincare-ot (Poincare-cost Sinkhorn), CURVCELL-SID, SUCCFAN-CURV-RQ, poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (ran), BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB.
OBSERVED: the occupied positions are (i) soft/OT assignment mass, (ii) codebook centroid updates (Frechet/Karcher), (iii) curvature-as-function-of-branching, (iv) residual transport/charts, (v) a post-hoc prefix-rank proxy.
REASONING: the unoccupied position is the *input geometry of the quantiser*: what point is being quantised, and how a behaviour relation defines a curved centre of mass for it. I chose successor-PROFILE equivalence (Hellinger/cosine on row-normalised transition rows) rather than raw directed edges, because raw edges conflate "co-occurs with" and "behaves alike", and every earlier round used raw successor edges.
OPEN: none for the answer; the deliverable is the single idea block.

STAGE: design scan summary. Read: round history (BRANCHCURV-SID, GEO-SHELL-RQ, GEOPFX, GEO_REPAIR, GYRO-TARGET, KAPPA_BRANCH, LORENTZ_CONE, SUCC-TAN, geodesic charts, cocond-markov-poincare-ot, CURVCELL, SUCCFAN-CURV, poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (ran), BFRQ-KARCHER, MIXCURV-FIBRE, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB) plus issue126 Q_H result (rho=+0.821). Observed: occupied cells are soft/OT assignment mass, codebook centroid updates, curvature-from-branching, residual transport/charts, and a post-hoc prefix proxy. Reasoning: the unoccupied cell is the geometry of the quantiser INPUT - which point is quantised - via behaviour equivalence over successor PROFILES (Hellinger/cosine of transition rows) rather than raw directed edges. Open: nothing blocking; full idea printed in the chat answer.

STAGE: final answer (condensed; full block printed in the response).
IDEA: LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ
Core: encoder z_i -> exp_0^kappa lift -> Minkowski convex mean (0.5 self + 0.5 successor-profile twins, K=round(median out-degree), w from Hellinger cosine of row-normalised training transition profiles) -> proj onto hyperboloid -> r_1=log_0 -> Lorentzian RQ chain (argmin d_H, residual r-log_0(e)). kappa=1 documented default, alpha=0.5 documented default, no sweeps, no ablations run.
Switches: behaviour off alpha=0,w=0; geometry off kappa->0 (Euclidean mean + L2); both on = the single trained arm.
Cost: smoothing ~2.7e5 MAC/step vs ~2.5e7 MAC assignment; Lorentzian cost same order as replaced L2; +4.2% encoder (one no-grad epoch refresh); one-off sparse P P^T graph build 1-3 min.
Observables: L1 prefix purity, successor-pair prefix sharing, issue126 Q_H recomputed, Stage-3 test_recall@10 vs 0.065.
Safeguards: arcosh clamp 1+1e-7, tangent norm clamp atanh(1-1e-5), re-project after every op (future timelike cone is convex), zero-row handling, duplicate-twin removal, float64 arcosh branch, codebook init by lifting baseline, frozen-graph hash assert.
Leakage: transitions counted on training split only, graph frozen before Stage 2, no val/test read.
Risk: content smoothing washes out item identity; sparse popularity-skewed graph; alpha fixed at first try.
